content_sections.heading: NIIMH Senior Research Fellow (Botany) Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIIMH Senior Research Fellow (Botany) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to send the bio-data by email for the NIIMH recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your bio-data by email for the NIIMH Senior Research Fellow (Botany) recruitment is 29 September 2026. Ensure you submit it before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the walk-in interview date for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Research Fellow (Botany) position at NIIMH is scheduled for 01 October 2026. Be sure to arrive on time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (Botany) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Botany from a recognized University or Institution, along with at least 02 years of research or teaching experience in Botany.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this NIIMH recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (Botany) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (Botany) post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/- plus admissible House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the NIIMH Senior Research Fellow (Botany) recruitment will involve a Written Test (which can be conducted online or offline) followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the National Institute of Indian Medical Heritage (NIIMH) in Hyderabad, Telangana. The exact venue address will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of your educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificate (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the National Institute of Indian Medical Heritage (NIIMH) for the Senior Research Fellow (Botany) post.
